conditions.title: The core mutation and migration path carries no open bootstrap-blocking defect.

items.title: The first-usable floor validator passes
items.requirement: check-floor-readiness.py passes, which is true only when every first-usable floor condition is satisfied or explicitly out of scope.

items.title: A released binary opens a database migrated by a newer worktree
items.requirement: A released binary opens a store whose schema a newer worktree migrated, proven by a passing test. Tracked by the linked issue until the fix and its test land.

items.title: An adapter and core version skew fails typed, not opaque
items.requirement: An adapter running against a newer core returns a typed version-skew result with a restart recovery action, not an opaque malformed-core-response, proven by a passing test.

items.title: The main-checkout refusal scope is not a bootstrap blocker
items.requirement: The main-checkout mutation refusal is an accepted authority boundary under CD-0008, not a bootstrap defect. Its refinement is tracked separately and does not block alpha, so it is recorded out of scope for this rung. See issue 627.
items.reason: The main-checkout refusal is an accepted CD-0008 authority boundary, not a defect. Issue 627 refines its scoping by capability, which is an ergonomic improvement rather than a bootstrap blocker, so it does not gate alpha.
